richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there is a possibility the front suspension castings could fail.
richiami.titolo: Replace the Front suspension air bag castings

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that number one air tank mounting bracket could fail.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the existing air tank brackets with a new designed bracket on specific vehicles.
richiami.titolo: There is a possibility that number one air tank mounting bracket could fail.

richiami.difetto: A degrade of emissions control components may occur.
richiami.rimedio: Trucks are monitored via software. If degradation is found then replacement of the silencer is required.
richiami.titolo: A Degrade of emissions control component may occur

richiami.difetto: There is potentially a mismatch of splines between a joint and the shaft on the steering column.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect the joint and check it is stamped with correct reference number and contact replace if needed.
richiami.titolo: THERE IS POTENTIALLY A MISMATCH OF SPLINES BETWEEN A JOINT AND THE SHAFT ON THE STEERING COLUMN.

richiami.difetto: The ABS Modulator plugs could potentially have been plugged into the wrong modulator.
richiami.rimedio: Perform checks and in necessary switch the ABS modulator plugs to the correct modulator.
richiami.titolo: THE ABS MODULATOR PLUGS COULD HAVE POTENTIALLY BEEN PLUGGED INTO THE WRONG MODULATOR

richiami.difetto: The ABS Modulator plugs could potentially have been plugged into the wrong modulator.
richiami.rimedio: Perform checks and in necessary switch the ABS modulator plugs to the correct modulator.
richiami.titolo: THE ABS MODULATOR PLUGS COULD HAVE POTENTIALLY BEEN PLUGGED INTO THE WRONG MODULATOR

richiami.difetto: Axle hub bolts may become insecure.
richiami.rimedio: Recheck torque value of axle hub bolts to 500nm.

richiami.difetto: Due to a lack of durability the steering lever may fracture at its fixings.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehciles replace the steering arm with a new design of arm.

richiami.difetto: Wheel knave may break away from the outer ring due to poor weld penetration. This could lead to the wheel breaking and could cause damage to vehicle.

The brake actuator clamping bands on the front axle may be weakened through fouling the shock absorber top mounting when the steering is on full lock and the brake pads are worn considerably. In time the clamping ring may fail and the braking effort at the front axle will be lost resulting in much longer stopping distances.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the top shock absorber brackets of the front axle and if there has been any signs of fouling fit new actuator clamping rings.

richiami.difetto: The front hub outer ring portion that houses the wheel bolts may break away from the inner nave portion fastened to the stub axle. In the worst case this would lead to detachment of the wheel.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect vehicles in the affected range and replace any defective hubs found.
richiami.titolo: FRONT HUB CASTING MAY FAIL IN AREA OF WHEEL BOLTS.

richiami.difetto: Possibility of momentary loss of power from Power Steering hydraulic pump unit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit additional filter to pump suction line.

richiami.difetto: The second steer axle relay lever pivot bracket may crack. Complete failure of the bracket could impair the directional control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a modified relay lever bracket.

richiami.difetto: The left hand lower noise shield may contact the vehicle silencer and cause heat damage to the shield. Whilst the shield is constructed of and supported by self extinguishing material trapped / collected debris or refuse in the area of the shield
richiami.rimedio: Dennis Eagle have written to operators of all affected vehicles advising them to remove the heat shield with immediate effect and to report back to the manufacturer that this has been done.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the drive axle and/or the link steer axle U bolts nuts were not fully torqued during build. This may result in misalignment of the axles.
richiami.rimedio: Dennis Eagle have contacted the operators of all the vehicles concerned both by telephone and in writing advising them to check and retorque the subject bolts immediately notifying the manufacturer in writing when this action has been completed.

richiami.difetto: The Knorr - Bremse handbrake control valve may have suffered premature wear. This could allow the vehicle to roll away whilst parked.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles to have the control valve internal mechanism examined for compliance with the valve manufacturers standards. Any valve which does not conform to these standards will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION OF HANDBRAKE CONTROL VALVE
